components.name: Popover/ContentPlaceholder
components.description: The default target of Popover.contentSlot (INSTANCE_SWAP). It exists because an INSTANCE_SWAP needs a real component as its default and 0.9 forbids a blank default (a blank hides layout bugs). It is also the canonical shape of a CONTENT popover: a body paragraph at body-sm plus, optionally, ONE action rendered as Button Variant=Ghost Size=Medium on its own line - the 28.9 rule that replaces inline links (which cannot meet 44px in a 24.2px Bangla line-box). Single variant, no axes. HUG x HUG with max-width 288 (= Popover 320 max - 32 padding) so the Popover hugs up to, and never past, 320. WHY the action is a Ghost Button and not a text link: it gives a 44px target, it inherits Button's _focus and _scrim, and it keeps the popover's content free of inline links. Consumers swap this component for their own content component (a menu, a form fragment); they never edit it in place. Bangla (0.7): WRAP - the body wraps at 288 in both scripts; 4 lines at bn/body-sm is the expected worst case for the sold-out-size explanation; 160 Bangla characters is the hard cap for any popover body.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Non-modal click/tap-opened floating panel - the touch fallback for Tooltip, the container for Breadcrumb's collapsed-levels list, and (later) filter and account menus. Side[Top,Bottom,Left,Right] x Align[Start,Center,End] = 12 variants. WHY Align is an axis here and not on Tooltip (17.1): a popover is up to 320 wide and is routinely anchored to an edge control - the header account trigger needs Side=Bottom Align=End so its right edge lines up with the trigger instead of overhanging the viewport. Side is where the panel sits relative to the trigger, so the arrow is on the OPPOSITE edge; for Side=Left/Right, Align=Start means the arrow is 20px from the TOP and Align=End 20px from the BOTTOM. No state axis: a popover is open or it is not - the trigger and the content own every state (28.4). WHY it differs from Tooltip and must never be confused with it: it opens on click/tap only (0ms), never on hover; it may contain interactive content (links, buttons, fields, a menu); it is in the tab order and focus MOVES INTO it on open; it exists on touch devices - that is the point. Dismiss = Esc, outside click/tap, trigger re-click, route change. role=dialog WITHOUT aria-modal for content popovers (aria-modal on a non-trapping popover is a lie and breaks screen-reader navigation), role=menu + menuitem for menus. NO FOCUS TRAP: Tab moves through the content and then OUT, closing the popover - this is what distinguishes it from Modal. Background is NOT inert: clicking the page behind closes the popover AND delivers the click. Singleton - opening a second closes the first; popovers never nest. Geometry: HUG width clamped 200..320, HUG height capped at 320 then the Content frame scrolls vertically; padding space/4 (16) all sides (0 when the content is a menu - menu rows supply their own padding); radius/lg; color/bg/surface-raised with a 1px color/border/default stroke and Elevation e3 - the same light, bordered surface as Tooltip because the system has no inverse-surface token and a dark panel would invert in dark mode. Arrow 12 wide x 6 deep, same fill, border on its two outer edges only, built as a 45-degree-rotated 8.485px square clipped inside a 12x6 frame (manifest 05 Tooltip recipe) plus a 1px _arrow-mask that hides the body border where the arrow's open base crosses it. The arrow sits INSIDE the space/2 (8) trigger offset so its tip stops 2px short of the trigger. Collision: flip Side, then shift along the cross axis to stay 16px inside the viewport; Align is kept where possible and relaxed to Center if not. Portal at the document root above the sticky bars; inside a Drawer/Modal it is portalled into that container so the scroll lock does not clip it. MOBILE RULE (28.6): under 480px a popover whose content holds MORE THAN ONE interactive element renders as Drawer Side=Bottom Size=Small - a 320px panel in a 390px viewport has 35px of total margin, collides with the safe area and its outside-tap dismissal fights the page scroll. The Breadcrumb overflow list (2-3 links) and the Tooltip touch fallback (no interactive content) STAY popovers. Threshold is measured per instance at design time, not at runtime. Touch (0.8): the trigger must be >=44x44 - an info-icon trigger is IconButton Size=Medium with a 16px glyph; menu rows are 44 FIXED tall; Close is IconButton Size=Small (36) with its own _hit44; inline links inside popover content are FORBIDDEN because a 24.2px Bangla line-box cannot meet 44px - a popover carries at most ONE link, rendered as Button Variant=Ghost Size=Medium on its own line (the Popover/ContentPlaceholder Action layer is that pattern). Bangla (0.7): WRAP within the 320 max-width in both builds (content width 288); the commonest body - the sold-out-size explanation - wraps to 4 lines at bn/body-sm (24.2px/line) = 97px plus title and padding = 169px, under the 320 cap with no scroll; menu items wrap to 2 lines by switching the row from FIXED 44 to HUG with min-height 44 and padding-Y space/2; content cap 160 Bangla characters - beyond that it is a Drawer or a page. Never opens on hover: a hover-opened container with a button inside creates content the keyboard cannot reach.

components.name: Breadcrumb/Item
components.description: One level of a breadcrumb path. State=Link|Current, 2 variants. Link: Latin/Mobile/body-sm 14/400 in color/text/link (7.7:1 on canvas), NO underline at rest - within a breadcrumb the pattern is established enough that permanent underlines read as noise; hover and focus-visible add a 1px underline with 2px offset (CSS only, not representable in Figma), pressed is _scrim 12%, focus-visible is _focus at radius/md (host radius/sm + 4). Current: color/text/secondary at weight 600 (Latin/Breadcrumb/Current) - a WEIGHT-plus-colour difference so 'where I am' is never signalled by colour alone - and it is NOT a link: no _scrim, no _focus, no _hit44 (the set-level focusVisible property has no effect on State=Current by design, like Divider's showLabel on Vertical). Geometry: HUG x FIXED 24, padding 0, gap 0, counter-axis CENTER, white-space nowrap - the row it lives in never wraps or truncates (22.6). Touch (0.8): the visual box is 24 tall, so Link carries _hit44 spanning the label width x 44 tall; adjacent items are 8 + 16 + 8 = 32px apart edge to edge so two 44px-tall hit areas never overlap, and separators are pointer-events:none so a tap in the gap falls through to the scroller, not the wrong link. HomeIcon (icon/house 16, hidden by default, showHomeIcon) replaces the Label on viewports under 480px for the root level; showLabel=false hides the text at the same time and the accessible name 'Home' / 'হোম' is kept via aria-label in code - an icon-only breadcrumb root with no name is a common failure. Bangla (0.7): GROW - the item hugs its label; nothing wraps; taxonomy caps Bangla category names at 24 characters.

documentationInstances.label: Bangla long-string - Link
documentationInstances.expected: GROW: the item hugs to ~ 150px at Bangla/Mobile/body-sm; height stays FIXED 24 (bn line-box 24.2 fits with the text layer's HUG height centred). Apply Bangla/Mobile/body-sm on the board instance.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: The category path on every category and product page. Collapsed=False|True, 2 variants. It is a layout frame of Breadcrumb/Item instances separated by icon/caret-right at size/icon-sm (16) in color/text/tertiary, plus an Overflow control in the collapsed form. STRATEGY: SCROLL (0.7) - the row is FIXED 24 tall, FILL wide, clips, and scrolls horizontally; it NEVER wraps (a second line starting with a caret reads as a broken list and costs 24px above the fold where the product image belongs) and NEVER truncates (an ellipsised category name destroys the one thing the breadcrumb exists to give, and in Bangla it frequently removes the head noun). The scroller is scrolled to its RIGHT END on mount so the current page name is visible and the user scrolls left to go up the tree - the direction of travel. Row padding is 0; the page template's scroller supplies the gutter inside the scroll area (layout/gutter-mobile 16) exactly as Tabs does. WHY FIXED 24 and not HUG: a HUG height would be a latent two-line layout. COLLAPSE RULE (22.5): on viewports UNDER 768px with MORE THAN THREE levels, render level 1, the Overflow '...' control, and the LAST TWO levels (parent category + current page) - the parent is what a shopper taps to go back to the grid, the first level is the escape hatch. Desktop shows all levels (Collapsed=False); three levels or fewer are never collapsed at any viewport. The Overflow control is a real <button>, 28x24 visual with a 44x44 _hit44, aria-label 'Show N more levels' with the count interpolated, aria-expanded; on activation it opens a Popover Side=Bottom Align=Start listing the hidden levels as 44px-tall links (see layoutFrame 'Breadcrumb/OverflowOpen') - NOT an expansion in place, which pushes the page down and loses the scroll position. It stays a Popover under 480px (28.6 exception): a bottom sheet for two breadcrumb levels is disproportionate. Overflow hover = _scrim 8% (no *-hover tokens), pressed 12%, focus-visible _focus at radius/md. A11Y: <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> wrapping an ORDERED list - order is the meaning; separators are aria-hidden SVG, never '/' or '>' text (a reader saying 'slash' between every level is unusable); the current page is NOT a link (State=Current) and carries aria-current='page'; JSON-LD BreadcrumbList is emitted on every category and product page with the FULL path even when the visible list is collapsed - a visible/structured mismatch is a Search Console error. Bangla (0.7): SCROLL, items GROW - the deepest path measures ~ 514 (bn) vs ~ 490 (en) at body-sm, both exceed 390 and both scroll; the collapsed form fits a 390 viewport inside 16px gutters, which is why the rule keeps exactly two trailing levels. Bangla category names are capped at 24 characters in the taxonomy guidelines for this reason.

components.name: Pagination/Page
components.description: One page number in Pagination Variant=Numbered. State=Default|Current|Disabled, 3 variants. 44x44 FIXED (size/control-md), radius/full on the storefront (admin instances override to radius/md, as Button does), padding 0 with the label centred both ways - 44 is not expressible as padding + line-box, per 0.6. Label: 14px SemiBold (Latin/Pagination/Number) with TABULAR figures so the row's width does not change between page 9 and page 10; Current is 14px BOLD (Latin/Pagination/Number-Current) on color/bg/brand with color/text/on-brand - fill PLUS weight PLUS aria-current, so the state is never colour alone. Default: fill none, color/text/primary; hover _scrim 8%, pressed 12%, focus-visible _focus at radius/full. Disabled: fill none, color/text/disabled, no _scrim, no _focus (0.4; focusVisible has no effect on this variant). WHY a real <a href='?page=3'> and never a <button>: it is what makes the catalogue crawlable, middle-clickable and restorable on back-navigation. Each number's aria-label is 'Page 3', never bare '3' (which reads as a quantity); the current one is 'Page 3, current page' because aria-current alone is announced inconsistently on older Android TalkBack. Numerals are WESTERN in both locales (rule 36) - they are data and appear in the URL - so the Bangla build is pixel-identical. Touch (0.8): 44x44 natively; items are 8px apart so their targets tile without overlap.

documentationInstances.label: Bangla build - identical (Western numerals); two-digit page shows tabular width
documentationInstances.expected: No layout change: 44x44 regardless of 1 or 2 digits; digits are Western in /bn/ too.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Listing navigation. Variant=Numbered|LoadMore|Compact, 3 variants, each a VERTICAL FILL x HUG section with padding-top space/8 (32) and padding-bottom space/12 (48), gap space/3, children centred, and a Status line first. Numbered = the full page list for category, brand and blog listings - REQUIRED for SEO because crawlers need real paginated URLs. LoadMore = one Button Variant=Outline Size=Large appending the next page - search results and infinite rails ONLY, where crawl depth does not matter; it still emits rel=next URLs and is crawlable at ?page=n, so the button is a progressive enhancement over real pages. Compact = Prev / 'Page 3 of 18' / Next, the mobile form of Numbered under 480px, because the Numbered row is 7 x 44 + 6 x 8 + 2 x 44 + 2 x 12 = 468px and exceeds 390. PAGE WINDOW (23.5): always page 1, page n and c-1, c, c+1; an ellipsis only where it replaces TWO OR MORE pages (replacing one page with '...' is strictly worse than showing it); c <= 4 renders 1 2 3 4 5 ... n and c >= n-3 renders 1 ... n-4 n-3 n-2 n-1 n, so the row is ALWAYS 7 numbers + 2 chevrons and its width never changes while paging; n <= 7 shows all pages; n = 1 renders nothing. The default state here is c=3, n=18: 1 2 [3] 4 5 ... 18. Prev/Next are IconButton Variant=Ghost Size=Medium with icon/caret-left / icon/caret-right, 12px from the number run; at the ends they are aria-disabled='true' (focusable, so a keyboard user can discover there is no previous page; icon color/text/disabled; click returns early) - never the disabled attribute. The ellipsis is a 44x44 non-interactive frame holding icon/dots-three at size/icon-md in color/text/tertiary, aria-hidden, pointer-events none. Compact: Row FILL x 44, SPACE_BETWEEN, centre text at 14px SemiBold tabular with min-width 112 FIXED so the chevrons do not move between page 9 and page 10; tapping the text does nothing - no page-jump dialog. LoadMore: the Status line is REQUIRED above the button (without it the user cannot tell how much is left - the main reason load-more feels worse than pagination); on append an aria-live polite message '24 more products loaded. Showing 48 of 418.' and focus moves to the FIRST NEWLY ADDED item's heading; when exhausted the button is replaced by the status alone ('Showing all 418 products'), not a disabled button; FILL width on mobile, FIXED 280 on desktop. INFINITE SCROLL IS NOT USED on any listing - it breaks the footer, back-navigation restoration and screen-reader use. A11Y: <nav aria-label='Pagination'> (the second instance on a page is 'Pagination (bottom)'); real <a href> links with rel=prev/next on the chevrons; aria-current + 'current page' in the label; the Status line is the single aria-live=polite region where page changes are announced - the grid itself does not announce; NO custom key handling - these are links, Tab and Enter are the whole model. Bangla (0.7): numbers are Western and locale-invariant so the 468px row is identical in both builds; 'Page 3 of 18' -> 'পৃষ্ঠা 3 / 18' GROWS inside the 112 min-width; 'Show more products' -> 'আরও পণ্য দেখুন' GROWS inside the 280/FILL button; the Status line is the ONLY element that WRAPS ('418টি পণ্যের মধ্যে 24টি দেখানো হচ্ছে' is 2 lines at 358) - it is FILL x HUG and the root is HUG height, so the extra line is absorbed and no control moves. Touch (0.8): every control is 44x44 natively; LoadMore is 52 tall.

layoutFrames.name: Breadcrumb/OverflowOpen
layoutFrames.description: Documentation composite, NOT a component: the Collapsed=True breadcrumb with its Overflow control activated, showing the Popover Side=Bottom Align=Start that lists the two hidden levels as 44px-tall links. It exists so reviewers see (a) that the overflow opens a floating list rather than expanding in place, (b) the menu-mode Popover geometry - padding 0 on the panel, padding-Y space/2, FIXED width 240 (the larger of trigger width and 240), rows FILL x FIXED 44 with padding-X space/3, radius/sm, text Latin/Mobile/body 15 in color/text/link, hover _scrim 8%, focus-visible _focus at radius/md - and (c) the arrow pointing at the Overflow control's centre. The rows here are the recipe for a future Popover/MenuItem set (filter and account menus, a later batch); they are hand-composed in this frame because no menu-item component exists yet and nothing may be invented as a component outside this manifest's scope. The Popover body here is a styled frame, not a Popover instance, because an INSTANCE_SWAP cannot target a non-component content block. role=menu is NOT used for this list - they are plain links in a non-modal role=dialog named by the Overflow button (aria-labelledby), so Tab moves through the two links and out, closing it; Esc returns focus to the Overflow button.

newTextStyles.name: Latin/Breadcrumb/Current
newTextStyles.why: Spec 22.3 wants body-sm 14/1.5 at weight 600 for the current level. Latin/Mobile/body-sm and Latin/Desktop/body-sm are 14 but Regular; body-strong is 16/15, not 14; Latin/Button/Small is 14 but its line-height/tracking are button metrics and are not guaranteed 150%/0. A dedicated style keeps the current crumb metrically identical to its Link siblings (same 21px line-box) with only the weight changed.

newTextStyles.name: Bangla/Breadcrumb/Current
newTextStyles.why: Bangla parallel of Latin/Breadcrumb/Current at the same size with line-height x 1.15 (150 x 1.15 = 172.5) per 0.7; tracking 0 per the absolute Bangla tracking rule.

newTextStyles.name: Latin/Pagination/Number
newTextStyles.usedBy: Pagination/Page State=Default and State=Disabled; Pagination Variant=Compact centre text
newTextStyles.why: Spec 23.3: 14/1.5/600 with tabular-nums. No existing 14px style is SemiBold with 150% line-height. Named per component rather than aliased to Latin/Breadcrumb/Current so that a later retune of one does not silently move the other. Tabular figures are an OpenType feature (tnum) and cannot be stored in a Figma text style - set them on the text NODES (Type details > Figures > Tabular) and in CSS font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

newTextStyles.name: Latin/Pagination/Number-Current
newTextStyles.why: Spec 23.4 states the current page carries weight 700 so the state is not colour alone (23.3's 600 is the non-current weight). Same size and line-box as Latin/Pagination/Number so the 44x44 item does not change geometry between states.

newTextStyles.name: Bangla/Pagination/Number
newTextStyles.usedBy: Pagination Variant=Compact centre text in the .lang-bn build ('পৃষ্ঠা 3 / 18' mixes Bangla and Western digits); documentation board
newTextStyles.why: The Compact text carries Bangla words around Western numerals, so it needs the Bangla family at 150 x 1.15 line-height. Page numbers themselves are digits only and keep Latin/Pagination/Number in both builds (rule 36).

notes: BUILD ORDER / nested-before-host. The lead's instruction reads 'Popover, then Popover sub-sets, then Breadcrumb, then Pagination'; this manifest orders each sub-set BEFORE the set that nests it because Figma cannot create an INSTANCE_SWAP default (Popover.contentSlot -> Popover/ContentPlaceholder) or a COMPONENT_INSTANCE layer (Breadcrumb -> Breadcrumb/Item, Pagination -> Pagination/Page) until the target component exists. Dependency graph: IconButton (manifest 06) and Button (existing) -> Popover/ContentPlaceholder -> Popover -> Breadcrumb/Item -> Breadcrumb -> Pagination/Page -> Pagination -> layoutFrame Breadcrumb/OverflowOpen. Popover is still built before Breadcrumb, as required.

CONVENTION / nested instance property binding: a host property that drives a NESTED INSTANCE's exposed property is written as bindTo {layer: '<path to instance>', field: 'property:<propName>'} (Pagination.loadMoreLabel -> Row/LoadMore property:label, Pagination.loading -> Row/LoadMore property:loading). In Figma: select the nested instance inside the main component, and on that property click the 'Apply property' control to link it to the host component property. 'characters' / 'visible' / 'mainComponent' keep their meaning from manifests 04-05.

CONVENTION / layer paths in bindTo and overrides use '/' between nesting levels (Header/Title, Content/Slot, Overflow/_aria-label, Row/LoadMore), as manifest 04 did (Control/Minus/_aria-label). documentationInstances overrides that address a nested instance's property use the same path plus the property name (Item-1/label, Content/Slot/body, Row/Prev/ariaLabel). Two pseudo-overrides appear only in documentationInstances and are instructions to the lead, not properties: '_frameWidth' = resize the placed instance's root to this width; 'Row/LoadMore/_sizingH' = set that nested instance's horizontal sizing; 'Row/Prev/icon-fill' = override the nested IconButton's glyph fill (the aria-disabled appearance).

CONVENTION / rotation: the descriptor key `rotation` (degrees, about the layer's own centre) is used on `_arrow-square` = 45. The inset values given for `_arrow-square` are the UNROTATED top-left; place, then rotate, exactly as manifest 05's Tooltip recipe states.

CONVENTION / scrolling: the descriptor has no overflow key. Breadcrumb's root is clipsContent TRUE and the lead sets prototype overflow scrolling = HORIZONTAL on it. Popover's `Content` frame is clipsContent TRUE with maxHeight 288 (= 320 max-height - 32 padding) and prototype overflow scrolling = VERTICAL. Everything else is clipsContent FALSE (stated per frame) - Popover's root in particular, because the Arrow sits 6px OUTSIDE the body and would be clipped.

CONVENTION / size tokens on fixed boxes: where a FIXED dimension equals a size variable it is written as the token string (size/control-md for 44x44 page items and the ellipsis frame, size/icon-sm / size/icon-md on icon instances) so the lead binds width/height to the variable; plain numbers (36, 28, 24, 12, 6, 8.485, 112, 240, 280, 288, 320) are deliberate non-token geometry from the spec and are listed here so none is mistaken for an unmapped spacing value: 24 = breadcrumb row height, 28x24 = Overflow visual box, 36 = IconButton Small, 112 = Compact text min-width, 240 = menu-mode Popover width, 280 = desktop LoadMore width, 200/320/288 = Popover min/max/content widths, 12x6/8.485 = arrow.

TOKEN REMAP: the spec writes `spacing/N`; the real variables are `space/N`. Used here: spacing/2 -> space/2 (8), spacing/3 -> space/3 (12), spacing/4 -> space/4 (16), spacing/8 -> space/8 (32), spacing/12 -> space/12 (48). The arrow's 20px edge offset is a raw number by design (see POPOVER / arrow offset), not an unmapped spacing/5.

TOKEN REMAP / radius: the spec's parentheticals are stale (it writes radius/lg = 14, radius/sm = 6). The file's values are radius/lg = 16, radius/sm = 8, radius/md = 12. Bind by NAME. Consequence used in this manifest: a host at radius/sm (8) takes a _focus ring at radius/md (12 = 8 + 4), and a host at radius/lg would take 20, which has no token - no host here is at radius/lg with a _focus ring, so the case does not arise.

CONFLICT / fonts and style names: the spec's `en/*` styles and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' are stale; every text layer binds a `Latin/*` style (Hanken Grotesk) and newTextStyles use Hanken Grotesk / Anek Bangla. Mapping used: en/body-sm 14 -> Latin/Mobile/body-sm (Popover body, Breadcrumb Link label, Pagination Status); en/h4 16 -> Latin/Mobile/h4 (Popover Title; Desktop/h4 is 18 and does not match the spec's 16); en/body 15 -> Latin/Mobile/body (menu links in the layoutFrame). Mobile rather than Desktop variants were chosen because all three components are mobile-critical (Popover is the TOUCH fallback, Breadcrumb's collapse and Pagination's Compact are mobile forms) and body-sm is 14/150% in both sets anyway. If Latin/Mobile/h4 turns out not to be SemiBold, add Latin/Popover/Title 16 SemiBold 135% instead of overriding weight on the node.

CONFLICT / icons: Lucide -> Phosphor per binding decision 2. chevron-right -> icon/caret-right (separators, Next), chevron-left -> icon/caret-left (Prev), x -> icon/x (Close), home -> icon/house (NEW), the '...' glyph -> icon/dots-three (NEW, horizontal; the existing icon/dots-three-vertical is the wrong orientation for an ellipsis). Both new icons are fetched by the lead from @phosphor-icons/core under those exact names. Phosphor glyphs are FILLED: every icon here is coloured by FILL (color/text/tertiary separators and ellipsis, color/text/secondary Overflow dots, color/text/link HomeIcon) with no stroke and no stroke weight; the spec's 'stroke 1.75px' on the separator is void.

CONFLICT / separator size: spec 22.3 says the separator caret is 14px; the lead's brief says size/icon-sm (16) in color/text/tertiary. 16 is used - it is tokenised, 14 is not. Edge-to-edge spacing between adjacent items becomes 8 + 16 + 8 = 32 (spec: 30), which still keeps two 44px-tall hit areas from overlapping.

CONFLICT / Breadcrumb current page: spec 22.4 says State=Current is 'not a link'; spec 22.10's markup makes it 'so the last item is still a tap target for reload / scroll to top'. DEVIATION / Popover Header visibility: spec 28.7 shows Header rendered when `showTitle || showClose`. A Figma boolean property cannot express OR, and a layer's `visible` binds to exactly one property, so `Header.visible` is bound to `showTitle` and `Header/Close.visible` to `showClose`. Consequence: Close only renders when a title is shown. This is acceptable and is now the rule: a popover with a close button always has a title (the close needs a header row to sit in, and the title is what names the dialog via aria-labelledby); a title-less popover (tooltip fallback, breadcrumb overflow) is short content dismissed by outside tap / Esc / trigger re-tap and carries no X. In code the two remain independent and the X is absolutely positioned top-right when there is no title. Hidden children take no gap in Figma auto-layout, so with Header hidden there is no stray 8px above Content - this is why the gap is on the root (space/2) and not baked into Header padding.

DEVIATION / FILL under HUG: spec 28.7 wants Header and Content FILL x HUG and Title FILL inside a HUG x HUG root clamped 200..320 - Figma does not allow a child to FILL an axis its parent HUGs (manifest 05 Tooltip precedent). Header and Content are therefore HUG x HUG with maxWidth 288 (= 320 - 2 x 16); the placeholder Body text is HUG with maxWidth 288 and auto-wrap, so the root hugs up to exactly 320 and never past it, and short content hugs down to the 200 min-width. Title is HUG with maxWidth 244 (= 288 - 8 gap - 36 Close) so it wraps BEFORE the Close button instead of running under it; when Close is hidden the title still wraps at 244 rather than 288 - a Figma-only divergence from the CSS flex:1 title, recorded because 'Why is this unavailable?' at 16px SemiBold is ~ 190px and does not reach it. Header counter-axis alignment is MIN (top) so the Close sits at the first title line on a two-line title (spec: 'top-right'); its glyph centre is 7px below a one-line title's centre, accepted.

DEVIATION / Breadcrumb/Item showLabel + showHomeIcon: spec 22.3's 'icon/home at 16 instead of a label on viewports < 480px' needs the Label hidden while HomeIcon shows; one boolean cannot drive two layers in OPPOSITE directions, so Item carries two booleans: showLabel (default true) and showHomeIcon (default false). They are mutually exclusive by convention; the lead sets showLabel=false + showHomeIcon=true on the mobile root item. The Item's accessible name in that state is aria-label='Home' / 'হোম' in code - the hidden Label text is the record of it in Figma.

DEVIATION / Breadcrumb.overflowFocusVisible is an ADDED property (spec 22.2 lists only overflowAriaLabel on the frame). 0.2 says every interactive primitive exposes focusVisible; the Overflow control is interactive and lives inside Breadcrumb, so its _focus needs a host property to be toggled on the board. Breadcrumb/Item exposes its own focusVisible per 22.2.

DEVIATION / Pagination/Page State=Disabled has no _scrim and no _focus (0.4: no scrim, no shadow, no ring on a disabled control); the set-level focusVisible has no effect on it, as Divider.showLabel has none on Vertical. The aria-disabled behaviour that keeps a ring belongs to Prev/Next (IconButton instances), not to page numbers - a page number is never aria-disabled.

DEVIATION / Pagination Status is present and visible (showStatus default true) in ALL THREE variants, following 23.8's tree where Status is the first child under [showStatus] regardless of Variant. It is the component's single aria-live region, so Numbered and Compact need it as much as LoadMore does.

DEVIATION / Pagination.loadMoreLabel, loading and compactText bind to layers that exist only in one variant each (Row/LoadMore in Variant=LoadMore, Row/Text in Variant=Compact). Figma allows a set-level property that some variants do not reference; those properties are inert on the other variants. This follows binding decision 2 (one default per set) rather than cloning hidden LoadMore/Compact rows into every variant, which would triple the layer count for no visible benefit.

POPOVER / arrow construction (copied from manifest 05 Tooltip, now with Align). `Arrow` = FRAME, clipsContent TRUE, fill none, 12x6 for Side=Top/Bottom and 6x12 for Side=Left/Right, Ignore auto-layout, offset -6 on the edge OPPOSITE Side (Side=Top -> arrow at bottom inset b -6; Bottom -> t -6; Left -> r -6; Right -> l -6). Inside it `_arrow-square` = RECTANGLE 8.485 x 8.485 (12 / sqrt 2) rotated 45 degrees about its own centre, fill color/bg/surface-raised, 1px (border-width/hairline) color/border/default stroke INSIDE, radius/none; rotated, its bounding box is 12x12, so clipping to the 6-deep frame leaves a 12-wide, 6-deep triangle with the stroke on exactly the two outer edges and an open base. Square bounding-box centres inside the Arrow frame: Top (6,0), Bottom (6,6), Left (0,6), Right (6,6) - hence the unrotated top-left insets {l 1.757, t -4.243} / {1.757, 1.757} / {-4.243, 1.757} / {1.757, 1.757}. `_arrow-mask` = RECTANGLE 12x1 (Top/Bottom) or 1x12 (Left/Right) filled color/bg/surface-raised at inset 0 on the same body edge, ordered ABOVE Arrow, hiding the body's INSIDE border where the arrow's base crosses it. showArrow drives BOTH (bindTo array) - hiding one without the other leaves a 12px notch in the border.

POPOVER / arrow offset per Align: Start -> the arrow's near edge is 20px from the START edge (inset l 20 for Top/Bottom; inset t 20 for Left/Right), constraints LEFT/TOP; Center -> constraint CENTER; End -> 20px from the END edge (inset r 20 / b 20), constraints RIGHT/BOTTOM. WHY 20: the panel radius is 16, so the arrow must start past the corner curve; 20 = 16 + 4 of breathing room and puts the arrow centre at 26, inside the first 44px of a trigger whose start edge the popover's start edge is aligned to. In code the arrow follows the trigger's centre, clamped to [20, width - 32]; the Figma variant shows the clamped minimum.

POPOVER / placement and offset: gap trigger-edge to panel-edge is space/2 (8); the arrow is 6 deep and sits INSIDE that gap so its tip stops 2px short of the trigger. Collision: flip Side to its opposite, then shift along the cross axis to keep 16px inside the viewport; keep Align where possible, relax to Center if not. Portal at the document root above the sticky AddToCartBar and MobileNav; inside a Drawer/Modal portal into that container. Singleton. Max-height 320 then the Content frame scrolls - the Header never scrolls away.

POPOVER / layer order (top of the layers panel = first here): Header (in flow, hidden by default) -> Content (in flow) -> Arrow (Ignore auto-layout) -> _arrow-mask (Ignore auto-layout, above Arrow). Root alignment MIN/MIN, padding space/4 all sides, gap space/2, radius/lg, stroke 1 INSIDE color/border/default, effect Elevation/Light/e3 (Elevation/Dark/e3 on the dark board), clipsContent FALSE, minWidth 200, maxWidth 320, maxHeight 320. Header: HORIZONTAL, SPACE_BETWEEN / MIN, gap space/2, maxWidth 288, fill none. Content: VERTICAL, MIN/MIN, gap space/2, maxWidth 288, maxHeight 288, clipsContent TRUE, fill none. Slot: instance of Popover/ContentPlaceholder, HUG x HUG.

POPOVER / menu mode is an INSTANCE configuration, not a variant: padding 0 on the root (menu rows carry padding-X space/3), width FIXED = max(trigger width, 240), Content gap 0, rows FILL x FIXED 44 at radius/sm with Latin/Mobile/body 15, destructive rows text + icon color/feedback/danger with the WORD ('Delete order') and opening a Modal destructive=true rather than acting; a divider between groups is 1px color/border/default with space/2 above and below. The layoutFrame Breadcrumb/OverflowOpen shows this recipe. A `Popover/MenuItem` set is deliberately NOT created in this manifest - it belongs to the filter/account-menu batch.

In Hanken Grotesk the 85-character string may fit 3 lines (63px -> root 95 tall). Read the Body's absoluteBoundingBox after the text style is applied and grid-place from the measured height; the Side=Top/Bottom and Side=Left/Right footprints differ only by where the 6px arrow protrudes.

DERIVE: all Breadcrumb/Item `size.w` values (Home 38, Toys 32, Educational toys 108, STEM kits 64, Robot building kit 124) and the Collapsed=False (~ 494) and Collapsed=True (~ 348) content widths are estimates for Hanken Grotesk 14px; measure the Label layers after styling. If Collapsed=True exceeds 358 the row scrolls by design - that is not a defect.

DERIVE: Breadcrumb/Item `_hit44` spans the Item's width (constraints LEFT_RIGHT) and is 44 tall (inset t -10, b -10 on a 24px host). CSS makes the width max(100%, 44px); Figma cannot express a minimum on an absolutely positioned rectangle, so for labels narrower than 44 (Home ~ 38, Toys ~ 32) the drawn hit rectangle is 6-12px under 44 wide. Acceptable: items are 32px apart edge to edge and the rectangle is documentation of the hit area, not the hit area itself. Overflow's `_hit44` is a true 44x44 centred on the 28x24 box (inset t -10, b -10, l -8, r -8).

Collapsed=True: Item-1 -> _sep -> Overflow -> _sep -> Item-4 -> _sep -> Item-5. Root HORIZONTAL, MIN/CENTER, gap space/2, padding 0, FILL x FIXED 24 (FIXED 560 / 358 on the set so the variants can be placed), clipsContent TRUE + horizontal scroll, fill none. Item instances HUG x FILL (= 24). `_sep` = icon/caret-right instance 16x16 bound to size/icon-sm, fill color/text/tertiary, pointer-events none and aria-hidden in code. The page template wraps the Breadcrumb in the horizontal scroller and supplies padding-inline = layout/gutter-mobile (16) / gutter-tablet (24) / gutter-desktop (32) INSIDE the scroll area so the first item starts on the gutter and the last can scroll to the gutter, exactly as Tabs 20.6 does. Current = color/text/secondary SemiBold, no states, not a link.

PAGINATION / Prev and Next at the ends: aria-disabled='true', NOT disabled - focusable so a keyboard user can discover there is no previous page; glyph fill color/text/disabled (instance override on the nested IconButton); _focus still works; click handler returns early. The documentation instance 'Compact at page 1' shows this. rel='prev' / rel='next' on the chevron links. n = 1 renders no component at all.

PAGINATION / admin instances override Pagination/Page radius/full -> radius/md (as Button does per 1.3); the storefront keeps radius/full. Tabular figures: set 'Tabular' figures on the Label and Compact Text nodes in Figma's Type details (not storable in the text style) and font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums in CSS, so the row's width is identical between page 9 and page 10.

A11Y / Popover: trigger <button aria-expanded aria-controls> (+ aria-haspopup='menu' for a menu); panel role='dialog' WITHOUT aria-modal for content popovers, role='menu' with role='menuitem' children for menus; name via aria-labelledby -> Title, or aria-label when showTitle=false; focus moves INTO the panel on open (the container with tabindex=-1 for content, the FIRST menu item for a menu); NO focus trap - Tab moves through the content and out, closing it; Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger; outside click closes AND delivers the click (the page is not inert); closed state uses the `hidden` attribute so content leaves the a11y tree and tab order while the element persists and aria-controls never dangles; route change closes without restoring. Menu keyboard: ArrowDown/ArrowUp wrap, Home/End jump, Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, Tab closes and moves to the element after the trigger, type-ahead by first character. A popover NEVER opens on hover.

A11Y / Breadcrumb: <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> around an <ol>; separators aria-hidden SVG and pointer-events none; the current page <li aria-current='page'> is not a link; the Overflow <button> carries aria-label 'Show N more levels' with the interpolated count and aria-expanded, and its Popover is a non-modal dialog named by the button; the icon-only mobile root keeps the accessible name 'Home' / 'হোম' via aria-label; JSON-LD BreadcrumbList always contains the FULL path (collapsed levels included) - a visible/structured mismatch is a Search Console error. Bangla aria-labels use Western numerals ('আরও 2টি স্তর দেখান').

A11Y / Pagination: <nav aria-label='Pagination'> (second instance on a page: 'Pagination (bottom)'); real <a href='?page=n'> links, never buttons; aria-current='page' plus an aria-label that says 'Page 3, current page'; every number's aria-label is 'Page N'; chevrons rel=prev/rel=next with aria-label 'Previous page' / 'Next page' and aria-disabled at the ends; ellipsis aria-hidden and non-focusable; Status is the ONE aria-live=polite region ('Showing 24 of 418 products'; on LoadMore append '24 more products loaded. Showing 48 of 418.'); after a LoadMore append focus moves to the first newly added item's heading; no custom key handling anywhere.

MOTION / Popover: open delay 0ms (it is a click); enter = opacity 0 -> 1 plus a 4px translate TOWARD the trigger, fast 120ms decelerate cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1); exit = opacity -> 0, fast 120ms; reduced motion = opacity only, 120ms, no translate. Breadcrumb: no animation on scroll-to-end at mount (instant, before paint); link pressed = _scrim 12% + scale(.98) at fast 120ms. Pagination: page change is a navigation, no component motion; the LoadMore Button's `loading` state is Button's own spinner. Spring easing cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) is forbidden here as in every component in the spec. All transitions wrapped in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

BANGLA / Popover: WRAP at max-width 320 (content 288) in both builds; the sold-out-size body wraps to 4 lines at Bangla/Mobile/body-sm (14 x 1.5 x 1.15 = 24.2px/line = 97px); with title and padding = 169px, under the 320 cap, no scroll; menu rows switch from FIXED 44 to HUG with min-height 44 and padding-Y space/2 when a label wraps to 2 lines; body cap 160 Bangla characters. Breadcrumb: SCROLL, items GROW, nothing wraps or truncates in either script; Bangla category names capped at 24 characters. Pagination: numerals Western in both locales (rule 36) so the 468px row is identical; 'পৃষ্ঠা 3 / 18' GROWS inside the 112 min-width; 'আরও পণ্য দেখুন' GROWS inside the button; only the Status WRAPS (2 lines at 358) and the HUG root absorbs it. The `.lang-bn` build swaps each Latin/* style for its Bangla/* twin at the same size with 1.15x line-height; the documentation instances above are where the lead applies the Bangla styles.

MOBILE / Popover -> Drawer rule (28.6): under 480px a Popover whose content holds MORE THAN ONE interactive element renders as Drawer Side=Bottom Size=Small, decided per instance at design time. Stays a Popover: the Breadcrumb overflow list (2-3 links - a bottom sheet for two levels is disproportionate) and the Tooltip touch fallback (no interactive content). Pagination: Numbered -> Compact under 480px; LoadMore button FILL under 768px, FIXED 280 above. Breadcrumb: Collapsed=True under 768px with more than three levels.

TOUCH / Popover trigger >= 44x44 (an info trigger is IconButton Size=Medium with a 16px glyph); menu rows 44 FIXED x FILL; Close is IconButton Small 36 + its own _hit44; inline links inside popover content are FORBIDDEN (24.2px Bangla line-box cannot meet 44) - at most ONE link per popover, as a Button Variant=Ghost Size=Medium on its own line (Popover/ContentPlaceholder.Action). Breadcrumb: Item link >= 32 x 44 via _hit44, Overflow 44 x 44 via _hit44, separators none. Pagination: every page item and chevron 44 x 44 natively, 8px apart so targets tile without overlap; LoadMore 52 tall; ellipsis and Compact text non-interactive.

ICONS / INSTANCE_SWAP defaults: Popover.contentSlot defaults to Popover/ContentPlaceholder (a real component, never a blank frame, per 0.9). The IconButton `icon` overrides used here (icon/x, icon/caret-left, icon/caret-right) are all existing Phosphor components; icon/dots-three and icon/house are the only additions and are listed in newIcons.
